# Sponsor

![Resend](https://www.caniemail.com/assets/images/sponsor.svg)

Sponsored by [Resend](https://go.resend.com/caniemail).**Email for developers.** The best way to reach humans instead of spam folders. Deliver transactional and marketing emails at scale.


# Can I email…

Launched and maintained by [@HTeuMeuLeu](https://mastodon.social/@HTeuMeuLeu) and the team at [Tilt Studio](https://www.tilt-studio.fr/).


Based on the original [caniuse.com](https://www.caniuse.com/) by [@Fyrd](https://front-end.social/@Fyrd) and designed by [@Lensco](https://mastodon.world/@lensco).

Also based on the original name and idea by [@M\_J\_Robbins](https://mastodon.social/@M_J_Robbins) and the team at [Rebel](https://web.archive.org/web/20181007004741/https://www.gorebel.com/).

Support data contributions by the wonderful email geeks community [on GitHub](https://github.com/HTeuMeuLeu/caniemail/graphs/contributors).


If you see something wrong, please [report bugs on GitHub](https://github.com/hteumeuleu/caniemail/issues).
